review.tagline: Gradio web UI with plugins for translating and polishing papers and code
review.summary: GPT Academic is a Python Gradio app that sends text to OpenAI, Azure, Qwen, GLM, ERNIE, Spark and local models such as ChatGLM and MOSS. It adds one-click buttons and hot-reloadable Python plugins for polishing, translating arXiv, LaTeX and PDF papers, summarizing, code analysis and mermaid diagrams. Configuration is read from config.py, config_private.py or environment variables.
review.audience: Researchers and students who translate and read papers with LLMs
strengths: Plugins for arXiv, LaTeX and PDF paper translation, proofreading and summarization
Many backends: OpenAI, Azure, Qwen, GLM4, ERNIE, Spark, local ChatGLM and MOSS
Plugins are plain Python files with hot reload; buttons are defined in core_functional.py
Several API keys can be listed together in one setting
weaknesses: Documentation is mostly Chinese; the English README is a separate translated file
Gradio compatibility issues; requirements.txt versions must be used exactly
Full-capability Docker image bundles CUDA and LaTeX and is large
No user accounts mentioned; last tagged release is December 2024
needs: Needs Python 3.9-3.11, Gradio, LaTeX (for LaTeX plugins), Docker (optional)
Models: OpenAI GPT, Azure, Qwen, ChatGLM, GLM4
